reviewStatus: Initial evidence review completed; coverage remains partial.

automation.description: Automatic updates are disabled. This website displays a dated evidence snapshot; future source reviews must be published as explicit updates.

selection.scope: Civilian fatalities from explosive weapons; AOAV reporting sample
selection.target: All direct civilian conflict deaths in a comparable rolling 12-month global dataset

conflicts.name: Gaza / Israel
conflicts.scope: Baseline geography: Gaza only. This excludes civilian harm inside Israel and is not a whole-war balance sheet.

actors.name: Israeli armed forces
actors.note: AOAV attribution; deaths and injuries recorded in Gaza.

actors.name: Hamas / other Palestinian armed groups
actors.note: No comparable civilian-harm total admitted here. Gaza-only coverage cannot measure harm to civilians in Israel.

actors.name: Unknown / disputed
actors.note: Unattributed remainder explicitly reported by AOAV.

conflicts.note: Broad launch classes overlap narrower weapon types; do not add them to subtype totals. Historical official launch claims appear in the evidence register with their own dates.

conflicts.name: Sudan
conflicts.scope: Baseline geography: Sudan. The published non-state total combines forces and cannot be assigned entirely to the RSF.

actors.name: Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF)
actors.note: AOAV attribution; a compatible actor incident count is not admitted.

actors.name: Rapid Support Forces (RSF)
actors.note: Included in the non-state aggregate below; separate total unavailable.

actors.name: Non-state forces, combined
actors.note: Includes RSF and SPLM-N; aggregate, not an additional fighting force.

actors.name: Unknown / unresolved attribution
actors.note: Published attribution figures do not fully reconcile; no residual has been assigned.

conflicts.note: Source attribution subtotals do not fully reconcile with the conflict total. Preserve this discrepancy; do not invent a balancing category.

conflicts.name: Ukraine / Russia
conflicts.scope: Baseline geography: Ukraine, including occupied territory. It does not include civilian casualties inside Russia.

actors.name: Russian armed forces
actors.note: AOAV reports 14,525 civilian deaths and injuries combined; a separate death/injury split is not admitted here.

actors.name: Ukrainian armed forces
actors.note: AOAV reports 85 civilian deaths and injuries combined in Ukraine; separate split unavailable here.

actors.name: Unknown / other actors
actors.note: No independently reconciled death/injury split admitted.

conflicts.note: OHCHR’s July 2026 weapon-specific figures appear separately below. They use a different period and method and are not combined with this AOAV baseline.

reports.title: 31 reported deaths; civilian status not separated
reports.summary: OCHA relays 31 Palestinian deaths and 86 injuries reported by Gaza’s Ministry of Health. The count includes recovered bodies and deaths from earlier wounds.
reports.verification: Official casualty claim relayed by the UN. Not a verified civilian-only count or an event-date death count.

reports.title: Seven children reportedly killed
reports.summary: OCHA relays UNICEF reporting on seven child deaths. This is a reported demographic subset, not a separate total to add to the Ministry of Health figure.
reports.verification: UN reporting; case-level independent verification not established in this register.

reports.title: Israel states hospital-compound strike targeted a Hamas commander
reports.summary: OCHA records the Israeli explanation for a reported drone strike at the Al Aqsa Hospital compound. No compatible munition count or civilian toll is established here.
reports.verification: Official targeting claim, not independent confirmation of the target.

reports.origin: UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine
reports.title: 437 civilians killed; 2,610 injured
reports.summary: UN-verified monthly figures include occupied territory. Weapon-specific deaths: missiles and long-range drones 183; aerial bombs 105; short-range drones 111. These categories do not provide munitions fired.
reports.verification: UN-verified minimum; territorial access constraints mean incomplete coverage. Aggregate figures are not automatically assigned to one force.

reports.origin: Russian authorities, relayed by UN official
reports.title: Russia reports 250 civilians killed inside Russia
reports.summary: Russian authorities reported 250 civilian deaths and 1,596 injuries. Reuters reports that the UN could not verify these figures.
reports.verification: Official claim. Different territory and period from the Ukraine baseline; not directly comparable.

reports.origin: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights
reports.title: UN reports more than 1,000 civilians killed by drone strikes
reports.summary: AP reports the UN rights chief’s documented toll. The available statement does not provide a compatible count of drones fired or a force-by-force breakdown.
reports.verification: UN documentation relayed by independent media; underlying case dataset not available here.

reports.title: Historical claim: 13,200 rockets fired from Gaza
reports.summary: Reuters relays the Israeli military’s count of rockets fired toward Israel from Gaza. The same briefing reports 40,000 targets struck in Gaza; targets are not munitions.
reports.verification: Official military claims; no matching civilian-only numerator admitted. Excluded from the 2025 comparison.

reviewLog.result: Initial source review. AOAV 2025 baseline and seven distinct evidence records admitted. Current global ranking and matched munition denominators remain unresolved.
